recentItems.title: Russian drone strike on Ukraine's Dnipro train station kills at least 13
recentItems.description:
At least 13 people have been killed in a Russian drone attack in the Ukrainian city of Dnipro.
Officials say the drone struck a train platform at the city's main station. 
At least ten people have also been injured.
Ukraine's railway operator says a heightened threat alert had been issued, but many people were still on the platform.

Al Jazeera’s Audrey MacAlpine reports from Kyiv, Ukraine.

recentItems.title: Tanzania families demand justice a year after deadly election crackdown
recentItems.description:
It’s been a year since Tanzania faced protests after its disputed general elections. 
More than 500 people were killed in the violence that followed. 
A year later, families are still searching for answers and demanding justice.  

Al Jazeera’s Sammy Awami reports from Dar-es-Salaam, Tanzania.

recentItems.title: Zimbabwe turns to DNA tests to trace relatives recruited for Russia's war
recentItems.description:
Zimbabwe’s government is conducting DNA testing for families of citizens missing or killed after being recruited to fight in Russia's war against Ukraine.
But it could be months before families get answers about their relatives. 
Russia is being accused of recruiting Africans to cover its losses in the war against Ukraine. Moscow has always denied the allegation.

Al Jazeera’s Haru Mutasa reports from Harare, Zimbabwe.
